pick.name: Uniwind (Tailwind v4 for React Native)
pick.what: Tailwind className styling for RN/Expo from the Unistyles team
pick.why: Same Tailwind v4 tokens/classes as shadcn web; free MIT core; Better-T-Stack default
pick.free_limits: Free core MIT incl. Expo Go; Pro adds C++ engine/Reanimated className (price not shown)

alts.name: Tamagui
alts.what: Universal styled components + optimizing compiler for RN + web
alts.why: Wins if you want one component set on web and native

alts.name: React Native Paper
alts.what: Material Design component library for React Native
alts.why: Mature MIT component set when prebuilt widgets matter more than Tailwind tokens
alts.maintained: release date not shown on repo page (opened 2026-10-28)

candidates.name: Uniwind (pick)
candidates.verdict: Tailwind v4 parity with web; active.

candidates.name: NativeWind
candidates.verdict: Larger adoption; v4 tracks Tailwind v3 semantics - pick if a template you use expects it.

candidates.name: Tamagui
candidates.verdict: Best universal web+native component sharing; own styling DSL, smaller adoption (203k/wk).

candidates.name: HeroUI Native 1.0.11
candidates.verdict: Good prebuilt components (Apache-2.0, 200k/wk) - layer on top of Uniwind if you want ready components.

candidates.name: Expo UI (@expo/ui 58)
candidates.verdict: Real SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose components; use for platform-native screens.

decision: Uniwind keeps one Tailwind design language across web, desktop and mobile. Choose NativeWind if a starter/template depends on it; add HeroUI Native for prebuilt components.
